title: Not worth 30 bucks!
text: [[VIDEOID:af0e89ac232556d27383fa9b3414e04e]] Not a terrible batch of stuff but it’s crazy overpriced. Like twice what you’d be paying for the same stuff from lootbox. I started last month with the Deadpool box... it was the same. I liked what I got, although nothing special, but it was NOT worth the cost. I thought I’d give it another chance this month and was disappointed I didn’t cancel. The shirt is bad. I got an xl, the arms are too tight and the neck hole is way too big. Like I’ll be showing man cleave. The pop figure is cool. The sticker and stress ball and tiny “dorb” figure are alright, just very cheap and not something I’d ever want or use or display. These “mystery box” things are sometimes cool, but the amazon owned marvel collectors corps is a rip off.
label: negative
